flashcard_questions.q: The total length of the path travelled by an object, measured in metres (m). It is a scalar quantity.
The straight-line distance from the start point to the end point in a given direction. It is a vector quantity.
A quantity that has magnitude (size) only, such as distance, speed or energy.

flashcard_questions.a: A quantity that has both magnitude (size) and direction, such as displacement, velocity or force.
The distance travelled per unit of time, measured in metres per second (m/s). Speed is a scalar quantity.
